- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": the address of a single person (see the attached people.csv), otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants".
- "revised_schedule": every schedule item or commitment whose time or place changes: {"id": node id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "place": "..."}. Empty list if nothing moves.

messages.subject: Venue change for CodeSprint on 21 November
messages.body:
Hello,

The Main hall is no longer available. The event is moving to the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine – Auditorium (Place du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre, 75116 Paris), pending final confirmation by the organizer.

What changes for you:
- Please allow about 20 extra minutes to travel to the new venue.
- The Awards session is now 16:30–17:00.
- Lunch is still planned around the same time, but the catering delivery location has changed to the auditorium.

We will confirm the final details shortly.

messages.subject: Venue change for CodeSprint on 21 November
messages.body:
Hello,

The Main hall has been cancelled. The event is moving to the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine – Auditorium (Place du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre, 75116 Paris), pending final confirmation by the organizer.

What changes for you:
- Please allow about 20 extra minutes of travel.
- The AV setup is now at 07:30 at the auditorium.
- The Awards session is now 16:30–17:00.

We will confirm the final details shortly.

messages.subject: Your workshop has a new room
messages.body:
Hello,

Your workshop at 10:00–11:00 is moving from the Main hall, room B to the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine – Auditorium, room B (to be confirmed).

Please allow about 20 extra minutes for travel. We will confirm the room details shortly.

messages.subject: Awards time and venue change
messages.body:
Hello,

The venue for CodeSprint has changed to the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine – Auditorium (Paris 16e), pending final confirmation. The Awards session is now 16:30–17:00.

Please allow about 20 extra minutes for travel.

messages.subject: Volunteer meet-up moved to the auditorium
messages.body:
Hello,

The Main hall has been cancelled. The volunteer meet-up is now at 07:15 at the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine – Auditorium (Place du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre, 75116 Paris), pending final confirmation.

Please allow about 25 extra minutes to get there.

messages.subject: Delivery location change for CodeSprint
messages.body:
Hello,

The catering delivery for 21 November is moving from the Main hall to the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine – Auditorium (Place du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre, 75116 Paris), pending final confirmation. The delivery time of 12:00 is unchanged.

Please allow about 15 extra minutes for travel and confirm access for the delivery.

The skill points to a reference.md for the exact shape. Let me read it.

The user asked to omit files, so I'll leave out the `files` key and produce the messages, revised_schedule, and volunteer_tasks.

Key considerations:
- The `to` field for individual people comes from people.csv (speaker emails, volunteer lead Greta Orchard for volunteer-related messages). For groups without a single address, I use a short description.
- "Attendees" (200) and "Workshop participants" (40) use descriptions since participants.csv was not attached. Workshop participants are sourced from participants.csv, which I don't have, so I use the description given.
- Caterer contact is not in people.csv, so I use a description.
- Effect "inform" for all groups.
- Revised schedule: only items whose time or place changes. Items marked "moved" with time/place changes in the scenario are included. Round 1, round 2, opening, and lunch have effect "moved" but no time or place change is specified in the scenario, so I include only the items with explicit changes: av_setup, volunteer_meetup, catering_delivery, workshop_s2, awards.
- Volunteer tasks: the scenario moves the meet-up to 07:15 at the new venue, which is a task for the volunteer lead.
